row.evidence: BrightEdge's trust page lists "SAML/SSO" among its security features and its Okta app "supports Single Sign-On", but SCIM and user provisioning are not documented publicly; the help centre requires a login.
row.notes: New row. BrightEdge (enterprise SEO platform) publishes no prices ('discuss our product and pricing' contact form). SAML SSO exists (trust page; Okta OIN app with SAML only), plan gate not stated. The support help centre (support.brightedge.com) is login-only: its public article API exposes 2 unrelated articles, and the API endpoint says documentation comes in an SDK provided to customers. No Entra gallery tutorial (404). With no public SCIM or provisioning docs, status stays unknown.
